assertion_order_scope: Raw successful assertion order retained separately. Per-site and per-callback counts are exact; no scheduling or chunk partition equivalence is inferred.
network_scope: Actual synthetic gateway/provider loopback HTTP; original #33 uses the real frozen Router and original injected evaluator fetchImpl, while #34–#37 use supplied route callbacks. No real evaluator calls.
capture_semantics: Complete selected callbacks and five helper statements restored unchanged except successful assertion-result wrappers. Recording delegates actual HTTP and original return objects; no clone/drain, substituted verdict, timing threshold or source clock changes. Per-peer complete bodies preserve actual parser-delivered bytes; raw push chunks and chronological reads remain in raw observations. Provider request bodies remain unread by the original callbacks. Original #33 fallback/tool continuation and all complete outcome/privacy assertions remain intact. Distinct repeated fixtures in #36/#37 keep their actual fixture indexes and authorities. Original sink throws, returned rejections and never-ready Promises keep their actual return objects and emitter-installed handlers. Deterministic #34 latencies 7/5 remain exact; only actual measured #33 routing/classification latency is projected with retained raw values. The status callback Promise catch method is observed only when the original safe emitter installs and executes its own handler; the recorder never adds a detached rejection handler. Asynchronous assertions are counted only after their original Promise resolves successfully.
typed_observations: Headers inputs are enumerated into their complete normalized field map.
Route signal observation records actual AbortSignal type and aborted state; no serialized object identity is claimed. countTokens is recorded as a function capability only.
Individual response chunks remain base64, including intentionally split UTF-8. Only complete request bodies use UTF-8 after exact roundtrip validation.
